content: IḴI DANAB AG KAYAKNU SIPSIP TUTUḴU ATOG NOADḴULAGNU NAI

Ahilḵad iḵi danab amu, da ag oolagp̱a da ele iḵi danab bemi daaṯem, da amelp̱anab Kristus Nug ug mawe anidmi, da ag ele, ig oh geha Kayaknu ehaniṯak oḵai amu heeb miag atieb aognig amunu da ag iḵi danab ag uḏat inam heḵulagnu ag maḏ adaḵulnu nai imu yaaṯem.

Ag Kayaknu danab sipsip bia ag ep̱elagp̱a daaṯeb amu atog noadna autna aweg! Ag ḏo waap̱a bia daanna, toliak uḏat aib hep̱ig. Iiṯa, ag Kayak oo niiṯe amubia ena doonna heḵulag. Ag men doḏoib aoglagnu aib dab menana hep̱ig, ag oolag ahebeb heḵulag.

Ag toliak, ag Kayaknu danab, Kayak Nug ag ep̱elagp̱a maaṯom daaṯeb ele amu, ag amu dilagnu hamu bia anadḵulagnu aib hep̱ig. Ag kobol ena henana, danab ena daanna, ib ena amu Kayaknu sipsip ip̱uanadp̱eg dim lamiṯeg!
Anam dayeb amu Sipsip Gumak Danab anuqak daaṯe, Nug eḏua uḏieb, ag onig oḵai ii nauhṯe ele amu aoglag.

Danab bau ag onilag qep̱eg neeb, ahilḵad oḵai waalagp̱a dayeg! Ag oh ag nug waap̱a dayaknu kobol hena, lailḵad waalagp̱a dayeg! Aḏinu? Kayak naip̱a, nai amunu inam daaṯe. “Kayak Nug hibguiṯa danab amu ahilag ib oo neṯe amge Nug danab ag onilag qeeg neṯe ele amu, Nug ag ehanadṯe.”
Amunu ag aḵa ag onilag qep̱eg neeb, ag Kayak ep̱eg g̱agaṯag waap̱a daap̱eg amu Nug geha nuhig deḏp̱a ag humadḵu.
Kayak ag gumaṯa atog noadṯe amunu ag ug ahilag oh amu Nug ep̱egp̱a meig!
Ag hanhan dab mena autna aweg! Satan, nug am kekeḏ ahilag, nug am laion laa bia danab laa diia laadḵunu huanak gayaya oiṯe.
Amu ag oop̱a genab doyak ahilag g̱agaṯag aḏan daanna, ag nug mautp̱eg uḵaḏ! Ag dooṯeb, wan atu ohp̱a lailḵad daaṯeb amu ag ele ug ag dooṯeb bia doonna daaṯeb.

Kayak Nug am ehaniṯak oḵai hamu meḵak kobolnu diig daaṯe amu Nug ag Jesus Kristusnu uḏat oḵaip̱a, ag geha nuhig amahlak ena hanhan daaṯe ele amu, ag amu aoglagnu onilagp̱a eum amunu ag geha ug haen tutuib doonna daap̱eg amu dimp̱a Nug eḏua heeb, ag ena daaglag. Amu Nug geha humaṯa, ag g̱agaṯag aḏualaṯeb daaglag.
G̱agatag oh nuhigp̱a hanhan daaṯe. Genab.

Amu da Silas nuhig ehaniṯakp̱a da nai tutu imu ahilagnu yaami. Da nug am ig oh lainignab dooṯem. Amu uḏug imup̱a da ag g̱agaṯag aqaḵulnu, da ag Jesusnu nai oolagp̱a genab doop̱ig ele amu, nai amunu diig am Kayaknu ehaniṯak oḵai hamu megṯe, da amu ip̱uanadḵulnu yaami. Ag agup̱a g̱agaṯag dayeg!
Amu kristen tamaniak laa ag bia Babilon daaṯeb, Kayak Nug tituanaṯom ele amu, ag ele humaṯak nai ahilagp̱a meeg goṯe. Amu da beḵal Makus nug ele humaṯak nai me goṯe.
Ag nug humiṯak oo mauhak kobolp̱a heig! Amu ag oh ag Kristus ele ou qak daaṯeb amu, maḏoḏ ahilagp̱a daaḵunu ool daaṯe.
